## Summary

The 2026-05-01 and 2026-11-07 [[stripe]] Terminal captures describe submitting a finalized Apps on Devices APK through the Stripe Dashboard and monitoring its review status.

## Upload Flow (Dashboard)

In **Terminal → Software**, select **Create app**, enter the app name and package name, and open the APK upload window.

1. Choose compatible device types.
2. Upload the APK file.
3. Add instructions for the Stripe reviewer if the app requires review. See [[source-stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices-app-review]] for review eligibility and guidelines.
4. Enter one or more notification email addresses.
5. Select **Submit for review**.

## Monitor Status

| Channel | What it provides |
| --- | --- |
| Email | Stripe sends the review result to the addresses entered at submission. |
| Dashboard | The app details page shows review status. The Events page lists webhook events. |
| Webhook | Stripe sends the review outcome to the configured webhook endpoint. |

- `terminal.device_asset_version.app_review_approved` means Stripe has approved the app for deployment.
- `terminal.device_asset_version.app_review_rejected` means the developer must fix the issue and resubmit the app for review.

## Next Steps

After approval, deployment is a separate step. See [[source-stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices-deploy-dashboard]] for the Dashboard path. The November submission capture links to the [API deployment guide](https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/apps-on-devices/deploy-with-api.md). The separate November API guide describes access as private preview. See [[source-stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices-deploy-api]].

terminal-features-apps-on-devices-submit.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/apps-on-devices/submit, source-stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices-submit summarizes both full captures' Dashboard upload flow. After finalizing an Android app, its developer creates an app record with name and package, selects compatible devices, uploads the APK, adds reviewer instructions if review is required, enters one or more notification email addresses and submits it to Stripe (old raw lines 8-22, new raw lines 9-23). After submission, Stripe sends a review result by email, shows the status on the Dashboard app details page or sends terminal.device_asset_version.app_review_approved or terminal.device_asset_version.app_review_rejected to the configured webhook endpoint. The Dashboard Events page lists webhook events. Approval permits later deployment. Rejection requires the developer to fix the problem and resubmit (old raw lines 24-41, new raw lines 25-42). The revised summary adds these outcomes and links to the separate deployment routes.
terminal-features-apps-on-devices-submit.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/apps-on-devices/submit, source-stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices-submit retains May 1, 2026 as the original source and adds the November 7, 2026 full corroborating capture as a raw reference. The small wording revision to reviewer instructions, list numerals and status-table spacing are presentation. The deployment path changes from deploy-with-API.md to deploy-with-api.md. The full captures retain compatible-device selection, conditional reviewer instructions, all three status channels, approval for deployment, and correction and resubmission after rejection (old raw lines 8-22, old raw lines 24-41, new raw lines 9-23, new raw lines 25-42). The separate November app-review guide gives the P2PE and Verifone review scope and automated-approval cases for non-P2PE Stripe reader use, DevKit-only use and uploads of previously approved APKs (raw/stripe-terminal-features-apps-on-devices-app-review-2026-11-07.md lines 9-15). The separate November API deployment guide identifies access as private preview (raw/stripe-terminal-features-apps-on-devices-deploy-with-api-2026-11-07.md lines 9-15), and the separate Dashboard deployment guide documents the Dashboard route after approval (raw/stripe-terminal-features-apps-on-devices-deploy-in-dashboard-2026-11-07.md lines 5-13). The source keeps the reciprocal stripe-terminal-apps-on-devices route, the distinct review and deployment routes, and the boundary between review approval and deployment.
